What is a Positive Displacement Gear Pump?

A positive displacement gear pump operates by sealing a constant volume of liquid between its spinning gears which then delivers the liquid to its discharge point. The system maintains consistent flow rates which remain unbroken through different pressure conditions.

blocks.text: FAQs
What is the advantage of a positive displacement gear pump?
It provides a constant flow rate and handles high-viscosity fluids efficiently.
Which industries use SS rotary gear pumps?
They are mainly used in food processing, pharmaceuticals, and chemical industries due to their hygienic properties.
What is the difference between SS and CI gear pumps?
SS pumps offer corrosion resistance and hygiene, while CI pumps are more economical and suitable for heavy-duty industrial use.
Can gear pumps handle thick liquids?
Yes, they are specifically designed to handle viscous and semi-solid fluids.
Does Rotozest Industries provide customized solutions?
Yes, we offer tailored gear pump solutions based on your application needs.
